design: Existing pure verifier does not establish trusted currentness, enrollment, full-payload composition or atomic attempts; it is not a permit. Candidate lacks their consumers.

A content-free always-denying guard with no positive input or callback runs in handler before upstream reservation and in direct forwarding helper before HTTPS connection. It blocks all payloads on this path until a separately reviewed trusted consumer is implemented.
Denied calls increment existing local rejection accounting; they do not reserve an upstream attempt or fabricate a receipt. Existing evidence schema and supervisor remain unchanged.
Existing lower-level receipt tests explicitly bypass only this guard in their test utility, with no production allow switch; new denial tests never patch it.
